result.markdown:
If you mean **TPD (Total and Permanent Disability) claims through superannuation, income-protection claims, or disputes with a super fund/insurer**, there are several strong Sydney options. I’d shortlist these rather than choosing purely on Google reviews.

### My shortlist

**1. WKB Lawyers — particularly strong for TPD/super claims**  
WKB Lawyers  
WKB Lawyers
[Web](http://www.wkblawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Level 5/75 Castlereagh St, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia
Phone: +611800865225
WKB says it **specialises exclusively in this area**, including superannuation insurance claims and TPD, rather than treating them as a small part of a general personal-injury practice. Its Sydney office is at 75 Castlereagh St. [www.wkblawyers.com.au](https://www.wkblawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** One of the first firms I'd contact if the matter is specifically a TPD/super insurance claim.

**2. Maurice Blackburn — strong for complicated disputes/litigation**  
Maurice Blackburn has a dedicated Sydney **Superannuation & Insurance Claims** practice, including Principal Lawyer and State Litigation Leader **Craig Parrish**, plus lawyers specialising in superannuation and insurance. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/superannuation-insurance-claims/total-permanent-disability-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) The Australian Lawyers Alliance also identifies Maurice Blackburn's Josh Mennen as a specialist spokesperson on insurance and superannuation, including TPD insurance. [lawyersalliance.com.au](https://lawyersalliance.com.au/Web/Web/News/Media-spokespersons.aspx?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** Particularly worth considering if your claim has been **denied, delayed, or escalated into a dispute**.

**3. Berrill & Watson — specialist super/insurance firm**  
Berrill & Watson says it focuses on TPD, income protection, death/terminal illness and other insurance benefits, and specifically handles superannuation TPD claims throughout NSW. It also states that it **never represents the insurance company** and offers no-win-no-fee arrangements. [www.berrillwatson.com.au](https://www.berrillwatson.com.au/about/tpd-nsw/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** Very good option if you want a **specialist boutique-style practice rather than a huge personal-injury firm**.

**4. Law Partners — very strong specialist option**  
Law Partners Injury Lawyers Sydney  
Law Partners Injury Lawyers Sydney
[Web](https://lawpartners.com.au/offices/personal-injury-lawyers-sydney?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp-sydney&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Level 23/270 Pitt St, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia
Phone: +61292644474
Law Partners has a dedicated Sydney/NSW TPD practice, describes its lawyers as TPD specialists, and offers no-win-no-fee representation. Its Sydney office has a very large volume of Google reviews (currently 1,578 in the business listing). [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/tpd-lawyers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** A good choice if you value **scale, established systems and a large specialist practice**.

**5. Withstand Lawyers — worth getting a comparison quote**  
Withstand has a dedicated Sydney TPD/superannuation team and identifies lawyers who work exclusively in TPD and superannuation claims. It reports a 4.9/5 rating from 265+ verified Google reviews and a no-win-no-fee model. [www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/tpd-lawyers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** An attractive option if you want a **smaller, highly focused TPD team and hands-on service**.

**6. Aussie Injury Lawyers**  
Aussie Injury Lawyers Sydney  
Aussie Injury Lawyers Sydney
[Web](https://aussieinjurylawyers.com.au/legal-offices/superannuation-tpd-claims-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Angel Place, level 17/123 Pitt St, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia
Phone: +611300873252
They have a dedicated Sydney superannuation/TPD practice covering TPD, mental-health TPD, income protection, death benefits, life insurance and critical/terminal illness claims. The firm identifies Kerry Splatt as an Accredited Specialist in compensation law and says the team has extensive combined experience. [aussieinjurylawyers.com.au](https://aussieinjurylawyers.com.au/legal-offices/superannuation-tpd-claims-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
**My take:** Another credible firm to include when comparing costs and strategy.

### If it were my claim

I'd probably get **2–3 free initial assessments**, starting with:

1. **WKB** — specialist TPD/super focus  
2. **Maurice Blackburn** — particularly if there's an insurer dispute or litigation risk  
3. **Berrill & Watson** — specialist boutique alternative  

Then compare what each says about **your actual policy wording, likelihood of success, evidence required, expected timeframe and legal costs**.

One important point: don't choose a lawyer solely because they advertise a "**99% success rate**" or similar figure. Those numbers are generally the firm's own marketing claims, and the definition of "success" can vary. For example, Withstand and Law Partners both advertise very high success rates. [lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/superannuation-tpd-lawyers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.withstandlawyers.com.au](https://www.withstandlawyers.com.au/tpd-lawyers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Also, TPD claims can involve **more than simply proving that you're unable to do your old job**. The precise policy definition, your education/training/experience, medical evidence and the applicable policy terms can be critical. [lawyersalliance.com.au](https://lawyersalliance.com.au/common/Uploaded%20files/Submissions/2024/240304SubNational.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **whether your TPD claim has been (a) not yet lodged, (b) rejected, (c) delayed, or (d) accepted but you're disputing the amount**, I can narrow this down to the **best 3 Sydney lawyers for your particular situation**, including their costs/no-win-no-fee terms and relevant track record.
